messages:
maria.g: Heads up — noticed a permissions regression after the RBAC refactor. Some API keys lost their model tags and end up allowing embeddings -> chat calls incorrectly.
kevin.h: hmm can you paste a minimal repro or audit line?
maria.g: yes, from audit logs: `key_id=abc123 user=svc-indexer action=EmbeddingCreate model_tag=null intended=embedding` — call had content-type `application/embeddings+json` but token meta is missing `model:embedding`.
kevin.h: Oof. That sounds like the tag population path didn't run for legacy tokens during migration. Which code path sets the tag?
maria.g: `authz/token_service.assign_tags()` — migration ran new RBAC schema but skipped tokens with legacy KMS-wrapped metadata. The KMS unwrap flow didn't reattach `per_model_tags`.
olivia-sre: audit-bot just emitted a correlated alert: "grant_mismatch: key=abc123 routes=chat.create but payload=embeddings". Repro steps: curl with old key -> gets proxied to chat model.
kevin.h: Can we short-term enforce strict content->scope mapping in the proxy so mismatched payloads are denied?
maria.g: +1. I propose a hotfix: when token.meta.model_tag is null, require explicit route scope check (deny unless explicit allow). That should fail-safe new/existing tokens until we fix metadata.
kevin.h: Agreed. Also need a migration to rescan KMS-wrapped tokens and rehydrate tags. Who owns KMS unwrap? @sam.prod?
sam.prod: assigning to me. I'll write a one-off job to iterate tokens and rehydrate model tags from audit records / token-issue logs. Plan: 1) dry-run print candidates, 2) apply rehydration in batches, 3) add ownership tag to changes.
maria.g: Good. Also add an audit-entry for every rehydration with `recovery_reason=rbac-refactor`. We need traceability for compliance.
olivia-sre: For rollout: deploy proxy check behind a feature flag then flip after monitoring. I'll add a quick perf test — this check is cheap but want to be safe.
kevin.h: Tests: add unit for `assign_tags()` coverage + integration test where KMS unwrap returns null metadata. Also add regression test that embeddings requests never route to chat endpoints for mismatched tags.
sam.prod: timeline: dry-run today, small batch tomorrow, full patch Thursday. Will post job logs.
audit-bot: INCIDENT_NOTE: 3 affected keys discovered so far (abc123, def456, ghi789). All have been queued for rehydrate.
maria.g: Thanks. After rehydrate we should rotate keys for those services and invalidate stale tokens. Also update docs: token rotation checklist must include rehydrate step for RBAC migrations.
kevin.h: I'll open a short RFC to include migration checklist and the fallback deny rule.
olivia-sre: ping me once deploy is ready, I'll watch SLOs.
maria.g: TL;DR: hotfix deny-on-null-tag, one-off rehydrate job, rotate affected keys, add tests+docs. Assigning follow-ups in ticket SYS-8342. :thumbsup:
